message:
All deploy and door open/close effects now have MaxSpawnDistance components
Most stop spawning around 40m
288 effects modified
Fix allocations from anchoring of faces -> network groups

Fixed deep sea water height update copying the whole texture into a temporary array when joining a server
Drops a 256MB allocation, was the reason behind the third biggest client RATN crash
set foliage shadow blocks as default and enable behind grass quality level
Fix line endings

Testing out a test to find effects that are missing or having incorrectly configured MaxSpawnDistance
Needs some manual configuring still, curerntly flagging 1818 misconfigured effects
Added an inspector UI to automatically add the component with the alculated max distance it should be set to
Noticed this becasue we were spawning door-open and close effects every time a door was opened or closed even if it was hundreds of metres away, costs 0.1ms each time

Update: enable ContentDir build
- use Uncompressed, loose output while iterating
- clean up generated ContentDirRoot after build
Tests: made a couple builds
Fixed "Incorrect material array length" warning when opening some skins in the skin viewer
Fixed binoculars screen effect not working with domain reload disabled

Added net tab to the F1 menu, to replace the one from the old F1 menu
Shows ping, received and sent with graphs of the last 30 seconds, plus the client network stats
- Added UI_HistoryGraph, a simple bar graph that other tabs can reuse

Food spawned in loot containers will no longer spoil until the container is looted for the first time or the item is removed from the container (apple trees)
Exposed as an option on the container entity
Added tree.spawn_with_additions command that spawns a tree and forces it to spawn it's extras (honey + apples)
Add analytics for damage blocked by shields when players take damage
couple more attachment points zero'd

Uzi viewmodel
- added shell to top of mag
- set up system to hide shell on zero ammo count
- added events to show shell on return of new mag during reloads
Add IFlattenKeepsChildren to CinematicScenePlaybackEntity, should fix broken camera position in tutorial cinematic in builds
Also applied to water footsteps

All footsteps + impact sfx are now decompressed in memory
All ambience sfx is now streaming
Increase apartment building bounds as it was slightly too small
Serialize apartment building
Fix apartment building serializing some client only fields
Fixed deployables checking all changes to building blocks nearby instead of only the most recent ones
Remove "No marker above the terrain to spawn a new marker from position" log

Sort rooms per-floor to speed up the execution time
- 0.1ms -> <0.02ms / frame (only when in network range of apartment building) is very acceptable
Fix placing / destroying doors refreshing all doors on the server instead of only the door that was modified

Buildfix: stop QA island modifying splats because of saving with active paint mode
Was mutating the splat textures, erroring out unity's content dir build determenism checks
Tests: ran content dir - server build, passed

Fix entities placed in scene missing preprocessing
Fix boat building in editor with flattening enabled

Fixed mags staying invisible after swapping weapons mid reload
- Reload clips hide the mag with a HideLods event and show it again later in the clip, so holstering before that point left the mag's renderers disabled on the pooled viewmodel

Fixed the biofuel generator snapping to the wrong spot in corners with advanced snapping
- Corner snap now subtracts the bounds centre offset, like the wall snap already does

Fix rotation tilt on viewmodel barrel attachment mods
Fix muzzle flash points on third person worldmodel
Remove mod compatibility for 8x scope and burst module
Adding L85A1 blockout

Optimize apartment culling 
- cache transform
- early exit rooms that were already hidden

Further tweaks to uzi drop in hackable crates, avoid it spawning "on top" of the other guns, slightly cut bolty and lr weight to limit dilution
Keep elite crate and underwater lab crate spawn the same but have it come with some ammo
Scrap king page media
merging tattoo gun textures to /tattoos

Fixed players getting stuck in the computer station when the space behind the chair is blocked
- Added two dismount points beside the seat, only used once the rear three are blocked
- A refused dismount on any seat now shows a toast instead of silently doing nothing

Extend f1 console multilines up to 25 rather than 8
- Going more than 25 will make it larger than the console window

Fixed patrol heli rocket deaths not showing the heli on the death screen
Rockets were spawned without a creator so the explosion had no attacker
- Rockets now have the heli as their creator, so it gets the kill and its avatar
- rocket_heli and rocket_heli_napalm death info points at the Rocket and Incendiary Rocket items, so it reads "with a Rocket"
Code cleanup

Uzi loot spawns. Hackable crate, elite crate and underwater variant of crate_normal

Likely to revist this in a future update
Brutalist Rock - Adjusted hand position, updated and split models, updated prefabs
Removed all RRP condition shader keywords from the shaders
Added in M79 Grenade Launcher World Model

Bugfix: make sure ContentDirBackend serializes correctly
Tests: generated ContentDirBackend
added steam quare images and final store icon to scap king sitem
Stencils now overflow correctly in menu
add some placeholder stencils for testing

Merge: from remove_baseplayer_breadcrumbs
- Clean: remove error logs related to mystery client NRE
Tests: build simulator
scrap king - updated gibs and prefabs

Clean: remove all baseplayer NRE breadcrumbs and supporting code
Tests: none, trivial change

Fixed shore ice spawning over railway tracks - added a Rail TerrainFilter to `shore_ice_[abc]` to reject ice placement over rail topology. Existing checks at single points easily failed. Tested in editor, resolved.

Uzi - charm support and world model Picatinny rail
- world model rig re-exported with Picatinny rail, shown only when a sight is attached
- charm set up in 1p/3p
- supportsAccessories enabled on item
- attachment positions adjusted in 3p
Fixed roadside waterpipes sometimes spawning on top of a road at T-junctions - stage's SpawnFilter now excludes road topology during placement
ent unlock now works on steering wheels

Merge: from jobs4_default
- Update: make UsePlayerUpdateJobs default to 4
Tests: none

Update: turn UsePlayerUpdateJobs to 4 by default
Tests: none, trivial change

Moved stencils to a seperate tool (like eraser, brush, colour picker)
Eraser/stencils/brush get different slider values (so brush is small like a tattoo needle, stencils can be stamped much larger)
Clan logo appears in stencil section instead of brush
Stencils can't be tinted
add combat log entry for hitting gull groups
GetVisitingVendor should always return the oldest visiting vendor
Possibly fix NetRead.get_Position NREs
Fix NRE when opening the inventory screen whilst in a conversation
Fix the new phone conversations displaying wrong information when server commands have been used

Bunker entrance source scene - reduced radius/fade to be closer to monument footprint. Removed unncessary paint data (out of bounds) from splat maps to clean up falloff. Reduced blend map to fade to 0 within monument radius. Propagated changes to bunker entrance a-d prefabs. Tested in procmap.
Fix salvaged hammer animation events path in editor (wrong slashes)
Fix drop item binds dropping the held item from your belt when in the inventory

UZI viewmodel

- Add Picatinny rail to rig & updated
- set up rail to show when sights are attached
- adjusted attachment positions
- rail/mag ViewModelRenderers
Use stock extended properties whilst in a turret, regardless of how the stock set
restrict brush type and size
Cherry-pick directory case fix
Use short prefab name for weapon in combatlog
Flock audio distance fix
Adjust various UZI mod points
Draw monument gizmos when editing terrain to help line up painting blend/splat within the radius and topology bounds
main -> character_customisation
Brutalist Rock - Initial prefab setup, placeholder model and materials, loc, manifest, skins

- Removed all handle-to-identifier conversions within RustRenderPasses, as this was only needed for BiRP
- Further cleanup of BiRP only code in various areas
More performant light offset maybe.
Slightly reduced radius and fade of radtown to reduce overreach. Smoothed radtown blend and pulled it in slightly where it extended past the radius. S2P. Checked in procmap.

extended triangular prism splash damage bounds to grills and triangle hatches as well
- slight adjustment to trianglular hatch bounds
fixed scrap king building skin steam item sharing token with the building tier so it read "upgrade to scrap king" on the steam item

Fixed NRE in PlayerBoat.UpdateWake after rejoining a server
- boats destroyed by the disconnect level unload were never removed from the fx queue

Merge from snapping.
Applying additional related fixes/changes from yesterday.
Fix prefab syntax error
Guard OnAncestorParentChangedClient NRE
Removed LODs from UZI viewmodel
Reduced tile size and terrain map size of jungle_ruins_d to reduce radius overhang and unused splats. Ran S2P. Reviewed changes in procmap.
Cleanup
Rework belt select changes to support usable items

Redo the occlusion of apartment rooms
- check the camera position of the player instead of relying on the occlusion culling system
Codegen
light sources on water w/ shadows, water also receives sun shadows now as well
Fixed edge cases of the CH47 crate landing on top of the powerline pole at powerplant

Fixed more blocks not batching
- Jungle ramps, spiral, L and U stairs
- Container roofl ines
- Frontier square floor details

Fixed buoyancy points never respecting the nextSplashTime interval
Moved the interval to the parent Buoyancy component so it's shared between all points and lowered the minimum time between splash fx to 0.1
Fixes audio cutting out when driving through storms (starved audio decoders)
Updated the test to catch more stuff

Fixed RHIB drivers reaching for nothing with their arms stretched out
The pooled driver seat kept its cached RHIB when it was reused on another boat, so the hands went for the old boat's wheel
Fixed adobe woodbeams not batching (forgot to add the RendererBatch when implementing wallpaper)

Fixed the rest of the stuff not batching:
- Crypt stairs and spiral landings
- Adobe roof lines and low wall corners
- Brick roofs
- Twig roofs and roof lines
- Brutalist triangle spiral landing

viewmodel updates
- tightened up fire anims
- edited reload & bolt pulls to avoid clipping when using a scope
- added a new deploy with stock so it can be played at correct speed
- added sound events
- set deploy stock in animator back to 1
- scope attachment position update
Fixed gingerbread building skin not batching at all

PT boat turrets: front turret uses the regular crosshair & wider front aimcone - less damage on both
- Front 50cal guns: aimCone 0.2 -> 1
- Front and rear 50cal guns: damageScale 1 -> 0.75
give front pt boat turret the regular crosshair rather than a dot
Fix line endings
Fixed HQM walls, frames and spiral stairs LOD0 blocks not batching
Updated Nailgun World Model to Fix World Model Nails having wrong UV Channels
Updated Nailgun Nails LOD distance so shouldn't change to quickly
Request the highest mipmap level for distance flares so they don't use a 1x1 texture (they have no Renderer component)
Fixed none of the ramps batching across all skins
Only spawn 1 boat group at large oilrig - not 2

Light ink opacity value in shader, brighter ink contributes a little less than darker ink to avoid colours being too intense/saturated
Simplified tattoo colours
FIx player legs freaking out after swapping between both turrets on the pt boat turret

Speculative fix for ocean water appearing inside canyons placed near the shore - extended Mountain topology on `ue_canyon_[abc]` to prevent Water topology where canyons dig below sea level.  This required a small radius increase on `ue_canyon_b` & S2P

Couldn't reproduce the original report.

merge from bird_critters
(lots of bugfixes, no added features)
Fixed space station roofs and wall corners not batching

Battery FX for half and full charge.
New script for better PFX system lighting. (Cookie support, rotation etc)
fix NPCNetworking test, gulls don't have the NPCNetworking component since they don't need the RustNavMeshAgent and things.

try fix entity_distance when shooting gull groups
- increase size of flying bounds
- flock tracks the group better, with an anchor parameter in the flocks
- scatter or "take off" phase has additional bounds step, as the birds spread out the most here

Fixed frontier building skin not batching at all:
- set read/write true on all FBXs
- set AllowSubmeshes to true on the ramp prefabs

first pass on improvements
- improved push/pull that actuall feels like it's pushing and pulling, much more intutive
- mirror mode for X/Z/XZ

One more CullWhenInside iteration, the previous one could cause big delays in bushes updating in the jungle, due to all loaded bushes clogging the work queue
Now: One grid for bushes, one grid for foundations, no work queue, no physics
Slightly lowered radius, fade, and blend map of satellite scene to stop huge radius overhang

Added test checking building skin meshes are all batchable
87 are failing

gull group fixes & improvements
- stronger obstacle avoidance when taking off from land point
- removed per-frame raycasts from the scattering run (might have been the stutter)
- add step height 0.1m for walking gulls, so they stay on the surface they landed on
- landing groups only startle against players within 6m, instead of any target seen in the last 15s
- gull corpses inherit velocity
- try fix "entity_distance" when shooting flying and landing gulls by adjusting bounds depending on state
- groups spawn in deep sea with a hook into DeepSeaManager, since populations make it not naturally spawn
- birds turning into animators are capped per frame because its the heaviest cost for reactivation

Fixed scrap king building skin not batching:
- set AllowSubmeshes to true on all prefabs
- set wall frame and floor triangle frame fbx as readable
Rich Crocodile pie icon setup/import
uzi balance + condition doubled
Don't paint grass or forest splat on ocean or oceanside terrain when placing monuments - fixes large monuments sometimes painting green patches under water
Fix RTL text not formatted correctly when passed as an argument whilst the set language is not RTL
Removed remaining Add/Get/Remove command buffer from camera/light calls and CameraEvents, as those are BiRP only

Update(editor): start working on ContentDir build process
Translation from AssetBundle mapping seems to work, need to figure out how to treat scenes and try actually generating data
Tests: ran it for server, inspected produced ContentDirRoot(unity doesn't recognize it, but raw data is there)

re S2P floating city scenes
- was missing seagull points

add gliding, birds in flocks dont flap while gliding downwards
increase flee distance to 1000 so they path across map and can be used to track explosions better
crows circle corpses from higher above
Fix animal names not working with RTL languages
Fixed AO issues on receiver.

Enabled mip streaming on 1012 textures (all have renderers)

- Props: 155 textures, ~301MB
- Deployables: 94, ~253MB
- Monument structures (apartments, rentable shops, industrial, blockers): 237, ~245MB
- Generic shared textures: 71, ~199MB
- Weapons, mods and charms: 74, ~168MB
- NPCs and animals: 88, ~132MB
- Tools: 30, ~82MB
- Player clothing and hair: 74, ~32MB
- Misc (satellite, horse, ladder hatch, event props, food, nature): ~313MB

At full res these were ~1.5GB of VRAM

iterate on fsm graph UI, restyle it to look more like a normal editor window

Testing auto resizing apartments monument terrain tile + textures to reduce footprint

add nametags toggle for demoui2
toggle fp turn in place by default

Setup IceSculpture IO as a subentity
- removed dead BaseSculpture protobuf declaration, nothing used it as syncvars were better
tune turn in place to be more responsive
Removed camera command buffer setup in the AmplifyOcclusionBase class
Removed the BaseCommandBuffer class as it's no longer needed
Removed the BiRP specific DeferredIndirectLighting shader and hlsl file. RRP has it's own
Updated Viewmodel to removed weird geometry

Map shop markers only refresh their info when the shop data changed
Was copying every shop's sell orders and Steam filtering its name on every map open
60 shops: shop refresh 4.2~ ms -> 0.4~ ms, map open 6.7~ ms -> 2.6~ ms

Map monument markers are built during world setup rather than first map open
19~ ms -> 2.7~ ms when opening the map for the first time
Deleted the old bloom scripts
Removed all deprecated custom bloom implementations
Deprecated the CommandBufferManager and removed dependencies from every script that touched it, as we don't need this in RRP
Updated M79 Viewmodel and Materials

Added M79 Grenade Viewmodel
Setup M79 Grenade Launcher Materials

M79 Folder Setup
Removed Blockout Meshes
Removed the convar for disabling RRP and cleaned up the initialization of RRP
Improve foliage shadow culling per split CPU performance by avoiding DrawMeshInstancedIndirect, just submit RenderMeshIndirect and cull per shadow caster up front

Made icelake placement much fairer so Ice Lake 4 isn't disproportionately spawning compared to the other 3 variants - larger icelakes now spawn more often.

Uses a new TerrainAnchorBlendGenerator to generate terrain anchors using the icelake's blend map so anchors are used more sparsely and only in the areas they are needed to make placement easier. The big disc anchors were too mean.

Manually reviewed all icelakes across 25 seeds and observed much more diverse placement.
Fix livestock being stuck looping when trying to U-turn in a tight corridor
Fix livestock pausing when being led making it difficult, when there is a lot of livestock on the server and the budget is at its limit
